description: Replace the ~44 generic 'Não foi possível realizar...' error messages app-wide with specific, debug-friendly, Portuguese messages that state WHAT operation/resource failed AND surface the underlying cause (Supabase PostgrestError message/details/hint/code, AuthError, or Error.message). Introduce a single shared error-formatting helper under src/lib/ and reuse it consistently, instead of ad-hoc `err instanceof Error ? err.message : '...'` and query-error-discarding ErrorText states. ASK 2 of the user instruction.
steps: Create src/lib/errors.ts exporting a pure function to extract a human-readable, debug-friendly message from an unknown error. It must handle: Error instances (use .message), Supabase PostgrestError shape ({ message, details, hint, code } duck-typed, not instanceof), @supabase/supabase-js AuthError (has .message), plain strings, and unknown/empty fallbacks. Design a primary API like `formatError(err: unknown, fallback: string): string` that returns a message combining the caller's context fallback with the underlying cause when available (e.g. `${fallback} (${underlying})` or `${fallback}: ${underlying}` — pick one consistent form), and never returns a bare generic sentence when a real cause exists. Keep it dependency-free/pure so it is unit-testable; put the PostgrestError field extraction (prefer message, append code/details/hint when present and useful) in a small internal helper. Keep output in Portuguese context labels provided by callers; the underlying cause may be whatever the backend returns.

Add unit tests src/lib/__tests__/errors.test.ts covering: Error instance, PostgrestError-like object (message + code + details + hint), AuthError-like object, string input, null/undefined, and the fallback-with-cause combination. Follow the existing pure-function test style (vitest describe/it) used in src/features/courses/__tests__/helpers.test.ts.

Replace the react-query PAGE-ERROR states that currently discard the query error. For each `<ErrorText>Não foi possível carregar X.</ErrorText>` tied to a query.isError, render `formatError(query.error, 'Não foi possível carregar X.')` so the actual query error surfaces with a stable context label. Files include: src/features/courses/CatalogPage.tsx (catalog), src/features/courses/CourseDetailModal.tsx (detail), src/features/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx (5), src/features/rankings/GlobalRankingPage.tsx, src/features/rankings/FriendsCourseRanking.tsx, src/features/rooms/RoomsListPage.tsx, src/features/rooms/RoomDetailPage.tsx, src/features/notifications/NotificationsPage.tsx, src/features/profile/ProfilePage.tsx, src/features/notebook/NotebookPage.tsx, src/features/gamification/MedalsPanel.tsx, and any other listed file. Inspect each query to pass its actual error object.

Replace the CATCH-BLOCK fallbacks that currently do `err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Não foi possível X.'`. Swap them to `formatError(err, 'Não foi possível X.')` so BOTH a real Error.message AND a PostgrestError (which is NOT an Error instance and was previously falling through to the generic fallback) are surfaced, and the operation-specific fallback is retained as context. Make each fallback specific to the operation/resource (e.g. 'Não foi possível salvar o curso', 'Não foi possível matricular no curso', 'Não foi possível entrar na sala'). Apply across: src/features/courses/create/CreateCoursePage.tsx, CatalogPage.tsx, CourseDetailModal.tsx, src/features/rooms/RoomDetailPage.tsx (many), src/features/rooms/RoomsListPage.tsx, src/features/rooms/api.ts (2), src/features/friends/FriendsPage.tsx (2), src/features/lesson/LessonView.tsx (2), src/features/auth/ResetPasswordPage.tsx, src/features/crud/CrudPage.tsx, src/features/notebook/NotebookPage.tsx, src/features/notifications/NotificationsPage.tsx, src/features/profile/ProfilePage.tsx, src/features/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx. In CreateCoursePage preserve the existing duplicate/unique-slug friendly special-case (detect on the formatted/underlying message).

Preserve existing behavior where the generic string was only a FALLBACK after a specific message (do not regress those into less specific text); the goal is that every error path shows the operation context AND the underlying cause when present. Keep all copy in Portuguese and user-readable. Do not alter non-error UI copy.

Grep after editing to confirm no bare generic `'Não foi possível realizar...'`-style messages remain without context or underlying-cause surfacing: `grep -rn 'Não foi poss' src` — every remaining occurrence should now be a context-label fallback passed INTO formatError (acceptable) rather than a standalone discarded-error message.
Run prettier so formatting stays clean.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/errors.ts exists with a pure formatError(err, fallback) that surfaces Error.message, PostgrestError (message + code/details/hint), AuthError, and strings, combined with the caller's Portuguese context label; it never returns the bare fallback when a real underlying cause is available.
src/lib/__tests__/errors.test.ts covers the error shapes above and passes.
Every react-query page-error state that previously rendered a bare generic ErrorText now surfaces the underlying query error via formatError with a specific context label.

Every catch-block that previously used `err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'generic'` now uses formatError(err, '<operation-specific fallback>'), so PostgrestError causes (not Error instances) are no longer swallowed.
No standalone generic 'Não foi possível realizar...' message remains that discards the underlying error; remaining 'Não foi poss...' strings are context fallbacks passed into formatError.
UI copy stays Portuguese. npm run build passes; npm run lint 0 errors and no new warnings; npm run test passes.
verification: npm run test  (errors.test.ts passes with the rest)
npm run lint  (0 errors; no new warnings)
grep -rn 'Não foi poss' src  (review: all remaining are formatError fallbacks, none are bare discarded-error messages)
findings: Added src/lib/errors.ts with pure formatError(err, fallback) + extractErrorMessage(err). It duck-types PostgrestError ({message,details,hint,code}) and AuthError (.message) WITHOUT instanceof, reads Error.message and plain strings, returns null for null/undefined/empty/no-message objects, and combines the Portuguese context fallback with the cause as `${fallback}: ${cause}` (code/details/hint appended as `[code — details — hint]`), returning the bare fallback only when no real cause exists. Added src/lib/__tests__/errors.test.ts (16 tests) covering Error, PostgrestError+code/details/hint, AuthError, string, null/undefined, empty, and the fallback-with-cause combination. Migrated react-query page-error ErrorText states (were discarding query.error) to formatError(query.error, 'context') across CourseDetailModal, CatalogPage, CrudPage, DashboardPage (5), FriendsPage, GlobalRankingPage, FriendsCourseRanking, RoomsListPage, RoomDetailPage (8 states), NotificationsPage, ProfilePage(n/a), NotebookPage, MedalsPanel, LessonView. Migrated catch blocks from `err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'generic'` (which swallowed PostgrestError since it is NOT an Error instance) to formatError(err, 'operation-specific fallback') in CourseDetailModal (3), CatalogPage, CreateCoursePage, CrudPage (delete), FriendsPage, LessonView, RoomsListPage (2), RoomDetailPage (8, including bare `catch {}` blocks now `catch (err)`). CreateCoursePage preserves the duplicate/unique-slug friendly special-case by detecting duplicate/unique on extractErrorMessage(err) before falling back to formatError. Left as-is (correctly, not discarded-error states): rooms/api.ts two `throw new Error('Não foi possível gerar um código único. Tente novamente.')` (these are the actual thrown causes, already specific and surfaced via formatError downstream); ResetPasswordPage static invalid-link paragraph copy; ProfilePage avatar-upload bare `catch {}` with intentional storage-fallback guidance (no captured error). All copy stays pt-BR. Verification: npm run build green (tsc -b && vite build); npm run test 147/147 pass incl 16 new; npm run lint 0 errors and exactly the 6 pre-existing warnings (Toast, AuthProvider, LessonView, QuestionComponents, NotebookPage x2) with no new ones; prettier --check src/ clean (remaining repo-level format:check warnings in a prior task review .md and supabase/README.md are pre-existing and were not touched). No live Supabase so error shapes validated structurally + via unit tests only.
